messages:
emma: quick eyes on this PR? it adds cross-account secrets provisioning + audit hook for external deploys. https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8723 :eyes:

raj: thanks — can you summarize what changes to KMS perms?

emma: short: new IAM role assumption for ops account + added kms:GenerateDataKey permission on the customer-managed key. also added audit log shipping to Splunk via an audit-hook Lambda. here's the key policy diff:
```json
"Statement": [{"Effect": "Allow","Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ops-deploy"},"Action": "kms:GenerateDataKey"}]
```

oliver: we should gate this behind a feature flag. any runtime migration? will it touch existing secrets?

emma: no migration path required — code path is opt-in via `ENABLE_CROSS_ACCOUNT_SECRETS=true`. rollout plan in PR description. needs one more security approval for the KMS policy change.

maria: i can review the KMS policy in ~2 hours. quick q: any wildcard Principals or `*` entries?

emma: none. policy limits to the ops role ARN. added a short runbook for revocation and rollback steps. pinging @security-bot for checklist.

security-bot: automated-checklist: KMS-policy-reviewed -> pending; secrets-scope-scan -> passing; staging-deploy-tested -> yes. label added: `security-review:required`.

raj: sounds good. i'll take the app-side changes after maria approves the KMS policy. :thumbsup:

emma: thanks all — marking PR as awaiting final approval. if no approvals by EOD i'll hold merge until approvals are in place.
